title: Describing People
description: Learn to describe appearance and personality
objectives: Describe physical appearance (tall, short, young, old)

target_language.grammar_pattern:
He is + adjective
She is + adjective
He has + noun
She has + noun

Examples:
- He is tall
- She is friendly
- He has black hair
- She has brown eyes

Question:
- What does he look like?
- What does she look like?

grammar_patterns.label: Asking about appearance
examples: What does your brother look like?

story.context: You are waiting for your friend Ali at a cafe. You call Marcus to tell him what Ali looks like so Marcus can recognize him.

dialogue.speaker: Marcus
dialogue.text: Hi! I'm at the cafe. What does your friend look like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: His name is Ali. He is tall with short black hair.

dialogue.speaker: Marcus
dialogue.text: Okay. Tall with short black hair. How old is he?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: He is wearing a blue shirt and jeans.

dialogue.speaker: Marcus
dialogue.text: Great! I see him. He looks very friendly.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, he is very nice and friendly.

drills.title: Drill 1: He is / She is + adjective
drills.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct adjective
drills.your_turn: Now describe someone you know using 'He is...' or 'She is...', out loud, and record it

drills.title: Drill 2: He has / She has + noun
drills.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct feature
drills.your_turn: Now describe someone's physical features using 'has', out loud, and record it

drills.title: Drill 3: What does he/she look like?
drills.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word
examples: What does your brother look like?
What does your friend look like?
drills.your_turn: Now ask what someone looks like, out loud, and record it

listening.question: Listen: What does Ali look like?
listening.transcript: What does Ali look like? He is tall with short black hair.
listening.explanation: The person says 'He is tall with short black hair'

listening.question: Listen: Does Ali wear glasses?
listening.transcript: Does Ali wear glasses? Yes, he wears glasses.
listening.explanation: The person says 'Yes, he wears glasses'

listening.question: Listen: What is Ali wearing?
listening.transcript: What is Ali wearing today? He is wearing a blue shirt and jeans.
listening.explanation: He is wearing a blue shirt and jeans

speaking.title: Task 1: Describe someone
speaking.instruction: Record yourself describing a friend or family member. Include: height, hair, age, and personality.
speaking.example: My brother Ali is tall. He has short black hair. He is 30 years old. He wears glasses. He is very friendly and nice.

speaking.title: Task 2: Answer the question
speaking.instruction: Someone asks 'What does your mother look like?' Record your answer.
speaking.example: My mother is short. She has long black hair. She is about 50 years old. She is very kind and friendly.

writing.title: Task 1: Describe three people
writing.instruction: Write descriptions of 3 people you know. Include appearance and personality for each.
writing.example:
1. My father is tall. He has short gray hair. He is 55 years old. He is quiet but very kind.
2. My sister is short. She has long black hair. She is 22 years old. She is funny and friendly.
3. My friend Omar is average height. He has black hair and brown eyes. He is 28. He is very smart.

writing.title: Task 2: Describe yourself
writing.instruction: Write a paragraph (6-8 sentences) describing yourself. Include your appearance and personality.
writing.example: I am average height. I have short black hair and brown eyes. I am 27 years old. I don't wear glasses. I am friendly and I like to help people. I am quiet sometimes, but I am also funny with my friends. My friends say I am kind and a good listener.

sections.title: He/She is vs He/She has
examples: He HAS black hair (describes a feature the person possesses)
sections.question: When do we use 'is' and when do we use 'has'?
sections.explanation: We use 'is' for adjectives (tall, friendly, nice). We use 'has' for nouns that the person possesses (hair, eyes, glasses).

sections.title: Adjective order
examples: He has short black hair (length + color)
She is young and friendly (age + personality)
sections.question: Can we use more than one adjective?
sections.explanation: Yes! We usually describe size/height first, then color. For personality, we can use 'and' to connect adjectives.

sections.title: What does he/she look like?
examples: What does he look like? (asking for description)
She looks like her mother (resembles her mother)
sections.question: What does this question mean?
sections.explanation: 'What does he/she look like?' asks for a physical description. We answer with appearance details.

sections.title: Describing Personality
examples: He is very nice and friendly.
sections.question: How do we describe someone's character, not just their looks?
sections.explanation: Personality words go after 'is' just like appearance words: 'He is nice' (personality) works the same way as 'He is tall' (appearance). Common personality words: nice, friendly, kind, quiet, funny, hardworking, honest.

quiz.question: Fill in the blank: He ___ tall.
quiz.explanation: We use 'is' with adjectives. 'He is tall' is correct.

quiz.question: Fill in the blank: She ___ black hair.
quiz.explanation: We use 'has' for things people possess. 'She has black hair' is correct.

quiz.question: You want to know what someone looks like. What do you ask?
quiz.explanation: 'What does he look like?' is the correct question for asking about appearance.

quiz.question: Which describes personality?
quiz.explanation: 'Friendly' is a personality trait. The others describe physical appearance.

quiz.question: Which describes physical appearance?
quiz.explanation: 'Short' describes height (physical). The others describe personality.

quiz.question: Fill in the blank: He ___ glasses.
quiz.explanation: 'He wears glasses' is correct. We 'wear' clothing and accessories.

quiz.question: Which is CORRECT?
quiz.explanation: 'She is tall' is correct. 'Tall' is an adjective, so we use 'is'.

quiz.question: You want to describe someone's hair and eyes. Which is correct?
options: He is black hair and brown eyes
He has black hair and brown eyes
He is having black hair and brown eyes
He have black hair and brown eyes
quiz.explanation: 'He has black hair and brown eyes' is correct. We use 'has' for physical features.

quiz.question: Describe your best friend. Include: height, hair, age, and personality. Write at least 5 sentences.
quiz.explanation: Use 'He/She is...' for adjectives and 'He/She has...' for physical features.

quiz.question: What physical feature or personality trait do people notice first about you? Why do you think that is?
quiz.explanation: This is personal reflection. Practice thinking and writing about yourself in English.

somali.description: Baro sida muuqaalka iyo dabeecadda dadka loo sharaxo
objectives: Sharax muuqaalka jidhka (tall, short, young, old)
Si sax ah u isticmaal 'He/She is...'

sections.explanation: 'is' waxaan la isticmaalnaa tilmaamayaasha (tall, friendly, nice). 'has' waxaan la isticmaalnaa waxyaabaha uu qofku leeyahay (timo, indho, muraayado).
examples: He HAS black hair (tilmaamaysaa sifo uu qofku leeyahay)

sections.explanation: Haa! Caadi ahaan waxaan marka hore sharaxnaa cabbirka/dhererka, ka dibna midabka. Dabeecadda, waxaan isticmaali karnaa 'and' si aan tilmaamayaal isugu xidhno.
examples: Wuxuu leeyahay timo gaagaaban oo madow (dherer + midab)
Iyadu waa da' yar oo saaxiibnimo leh (da' + dabeecad)

sections.explanation: 'What does he/she look like?' waxay waydiinaysaa sharaxaad muuqaal. Waxaan ku jawaabnaa faahfaahinta muuqaalka.
examples: Wuxuu u eg yahay sidee? (waxaad weydiinaysaa sharaxaad)
Wuxuu u eg yahay qof saaxiib ah (wuxuu u muuqdaa mid saaxiib ah)
Waxay u eg tahay hooyadeed (waxay la mid tahay hooyadeed)

sections.explanation: Erayada shakhsiyadda waxay ka dambeeyaan 'is' sida erayada muuqaalka: 'He is nice' (shakhsiyad) waxay u shaqeysaa si la mid ah 'He is tall' (muuqaal). Erayada shakhsiyadda ee caadiga ah: wanaagsan, saaxiibtinimo leh, naxariis badan, aamusan, qosol badan, shaqo badan, daacad ah.
examples: Aad buu u fiican yahay oo saaxiibtinimo buu la yahay.
Waa qof deggan oo naxariis leh.
Waa qof qosol badan oo dadka la dhexgala.
Waa qof wax badan shaqeeya oo daacad ah.

target_phrases: Isagu/Iyadu waa aad u [fiican/saaxiib badan/naxariis badan]
dialogue: Haye! Waxaan joogaa kafe. Sidee buu saaxiibkaa u eg yahay?
Magiciisu waa Cali. Wuu dheer yahay, wuxuuna leeyahay timo gaagaaban oo madow.
Waayahay. Dheer, timo gaagaaban oo madow. Imis jir buu yahay?
Wuxuu xidhan yahay shaati buluug ah iyo jeans.
Waa hagaag! Waan arkaa. Wuxuu u eg yahay qof aad u saaxiibtinimo leh.
Haa, waa qof aad u fiican oo saaxiibtinimo leh.

vocabulary.example: Isagu waa dheer, wuxuuna leeyahay timo gaaban oo madow.
Wuxuu leeyahay timo gaaban oo madow.
